items.title: Reconcile merged WordPress delivery through independent initiative-readiness receipts
items.body:
## Problem

The WordPress channel implementation is merged and verified, but BI-8D98C5E6, BI-28185C18, umbrella BI-F50B1E46, Workroom WC-38FD13D8, and epic EP-31C5A6C8 cannot reach terminal status. They were created and delivered before `initiative-readiness.v1` terminal enforcement, so their existing repository design, plan, review, delivery, and acceptance evidence is not represented by the authenticated receipt lanes now required. Decision IRD-D8392C6E9448 is the canonical blocker. The delivering development identity has no `record_initiative_*` grants, and an existing independent reviewer task explicitly declined the unrelated scope expansion.

## Scope

In scope:

- Dispatch or authorize the accountable independent reviewer identities for the design-checklist, architecture, data, UX, security, compliance, domain, plan, portfolio-traceability, and acceptance lanes.
- Resolve the immutable repository artifacts at merge commit `2b3ea261f841df1f68fcfe6720bda546044aaf92`:
  - `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-21-wordpress-channel-projection-design.md`
  - `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-21-wordpress-channel-projection.md`
- Record honest research, canonical baseline/spec approval, independent review, plan-review/coverage, objective mapping, acceptance, and objective-reconciliation receipts against BI-8D98C5E6, BI-28185C18, and BI-F50B1E46.
- Re-evaluate readiness and transition those three BIs, WC-38FD13D8, and EP-31C5A6C8 to their legal terminal states.

Out of scope:

- Changing the merged WordPress product implementation.
- Weakening or bypassing `initiative-readiness.v1`.
- Proxy-writing, self-reviewing, or fabricating independent receipts.
- Reclaiming the released WordPress source paths or nonproduction environments unless a reviewer finds a real product defect requiring new work.

## Acceptance criteria

- Every required receipt is attributable to an authorized, independent role and references the correct immutable WordPress artifact.
- IRD-D8392C6E9448 is superseded by an allowed completion verdict, or any substantive finding is filed as new governed work without mislabeling the delivered initiative complete.
- BI-8D98C5E6, BI-28185C18, and BI-F50B1E46 transition to `done` with server-resolved evidence.
- WC-38FD13D8 transitions to `complete` with zero scope claims.
- EP-31C5A6C8 transitions to `done` after child reconciliation.
- The recovery records PR #4478 merge `2b3ea261f841`, exact-tree evidence `cmt575xos031w01rmgbxkx8mj`, and final acceptance verification `RV-WORDPRESS-UX-4478`.

## Dependencies and evidence

- Blocks terminal closure of BI-8D98C5E6, BI-28185C18, BI-F50B1E46, WC-38FD13D8, and EP-31C5A6C8.
- Canonical blocker: IRD-D8392C6E9448.
- Delivery/evidence carrier: WC-38FD13D8, with zero remaining scope claims.
- Related but not duplicate: BI-812AC0D8 owns recovery UX; BI-0996913C owns external plan-baseline remediation. This item owns the concrete WordPress reconciliation using already-existing substrate.

items.title: Repair WordPress operator health and publication routing regressions
items.body:
Problem: PR #4478 shipped WordPress operator UX with three uncovered behavioral inconsistencies: failed health probes remain visually connected, successful probes do not refresh stored capabilities, and legacy channelId `wordpress` is recognized by the UI but cannot reach the publication adapter. The initial credential-persisting action is also mislabeled as a connection check.

Scope:
- Derive degraded setup state from the persisted latest probe result.
- Refresh bounded WordPress safe capability projection after a successful health probe while preserving the public-publication policy.
- Normalize the legacy `wordpress` outbound channel alias through the canonical `wordpress-self-hosted` adapter.
- Label the first credential action as connecting, not merely checking.
- Add regression tests first and refresh measured UX-fit evidence if the UI-impact gate requires it.

Out of scope:
- New WordPress capabilities, public hosting/CDN, schema changes, or new navigation.
- Initiative-readiness receipt reconciliation tracked separately by BI-237A7FBE.

Acceptance criteria:
- A failed probe renders a degraded/needs-attention state after refresh.
- A successful probe persists current site and capability fields without resetting publication policy.
- Both `wordpress` and `wordpress-self-hosted` drafts route through the canonical adapter.
- The initial submit action says `Connect WordPress`; the connected-state probe remains `Check connection`.
- Focused tests, typecheck, production build, and governed route verification pass.

Related: PR #4478; BI-8D98C5E6; BI-237A7FBE.

items.title: Deliver governed WordPress channel projection without making DPF a public CMS host
items.body:
## Problem
Many adopting organizations already run WordPress. DPF currently has no governed way to discover that site, assess which WordPress capabilities are absorbed versus retained, import inventory/read-only context, or project approved DPF content and structured business facts into it.

## Outcome
Deliver WordPress as the first external website channel on DPF's unified connector and outbound-publication substrate. DPF remains canonical for business facts, content intent, approval, audit, and scheduling. WordPress remains canonical for public presentation: themes, blocks/layout, permalink/SEO settings, hosting, CDN, and plugin-rendered behavior.

## Architectural guardrails
- No bundled WordPress/PHP/database runtime, public DPF URL, CDN, theme engine, or general-purpose CMS data model.
- Start one-way: DPF -> WordPress for approved publication; authenticated polling for discovery/drift. Webhooks and a thin WordPress plugin are optional later increments.
- Reuse IntegrationCredential custody, connector definitions/checkpoints/audit, OutboundDraft/Approval/ScheduledOutboundAction/OutboundPublication, media storage, and owning domain records.
- Resolve incumbent posture by normalized provider identity plus integration category/capability; never arbitrary provider-name-only findFirst.
- Per-resource authority and conflict behavior are explicit. No silent two-way merge and no WordPress content overwriting DPF operational truth.
- User-supplied site URLs require SSRF/DNS-rebinding defenses, HTTPS, bounded redirects, content sanitization, least privilege, safe errors, and auditable external writes.
- Reserve approximately 20% of every implementation slice for convergence/refactoring and invariant coverage.

## Initial scope
1. Provider/category identity and absorption-posture correctness.
2. WordPress REST discovery, health, auth, bounded incremental read.
3. Approved posts/pages/media publication with idempotent external identity mapping.
4. Structured storefront/catalog projection with preview, drift, and authority rules.
5. Setup/health/publication UX in the existing Integrations route family plus contextual Marketing/Storefront actions.
6. EA/parity evidence, positioning claims, operational docs, and adoption measurement.

## Acceptance
A founder/operator can connect a supported HTTPS WordPress site with a dedicated application password, see a truthful capability/authority preview, publish an approved DPF item as a WordPress draft or scheduled/public post, see its external URL and audit receipt, detect later external modification without silent overwrite, and disconnect/revoke credentials. Fresh install/unavailable/permission/plugin-conflict states provide one honest recovery action. Tests prove idempotency, approval enforcement, pagination/cursors, SSRF controls, sanitization, authority, and no duplicate publication.
